title: 4 Days Yellowstone and Grand Teton Adventure from Salt Lake City
includes: SLC Hotel Shuttle to and from the airport
Gratuities for tour guide and driver
Travel with an expert Tour Guide/Driver Guide for a Smooth and Insightful Journey
Ride in Comfortable and Professionally Maintained Vehicles (vehicle based on number of guests)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Age and Safety: Customers under 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Pregnant women may join if under 24 weeks by the trip's end.
Tickets and Charges: Pre-purchased tickets or city passes are not accepted. Buy through us or via the guide. Group reservations recommended.

Booster Seats: For state law, Children under the age of 6 require a booster seat in order to participate in the tour group. Please understand that the violations and fines are borne by the guests themselves. There is no need for a booster seat for bus travel on the day of travel.
Leaving the Group: If leaving the group early, inform the tour guide and sign a departure form. No refunds for unused portions.
Gifts and Refunds: Gifts provided during the tour may change due to unforeseen factors like weather. Fees will not be refunded for changes.
Hotel Rooms: Hotel rooms accommodate 2-4 guests, with varying bed types(e.g., King/Queen beds or two twin beds) and deposit rules. Deposits are usually processed via credit card.
What to Bring: Comfortable shoes and clothes, sun hat, sunglasses, sunscreen, cash, and drinks for hydration.
Closed Attractions: If a scenic spot is closed, an alternative will be provided. COVID-19 may affect attraction hours and capacity.
cancellation:
If you cancel at least 6 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel between 2 and 6 day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a 50% refund.
If you cancel within 2 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb: Experience the ultimate introduction to the American West on this expertly designed 4-day journey through Yellowstone and Grand Teton National Parks. Starting in Salt Lake City, travel in comfort with a professional guide who brings each destination to life, from the alpine peaks of Jackson Hole to Yellowstone’s world-famous geothermal wonders. Ride the iconic Jackson Hole Aerial Tram for sweeping mountain views, stroll along the shores of Jenny Lake, and witness erupting geysers, vibrant hot springs, and dramatic waterfalls across Yellowstone’s most celebrated regions. Wildlife-rich valleys, thoughtfully paced sightseeing, included park admissions, and comfortable accommodations make this tour the ideal balance of adventure, education, and ease. If you want to see the highlights of two legendary national parks without the stress of planning, this is the tour that delivers it all!
